blurb_html: Inside-out roll: sashimi tuna tossed with sriracha and sesame oil, a strip of mango, sesame rice outside, spicy mayo on top.
description: Inside-out roll: sashimi tuna tossed with sriracha and sesame oil, a strip of mango, sesame rice outside, spicy mayo on top.

items.amount_html: 220 g (110 g per roll)
115 g (4 oz)
2, thinly sliced (keep a few for the top)
~60 g, in 1 cm sticks
1 sheet, cut in half crosswise
60 ml (¼ cup)
240 ml (1 cup)

intro_html: An inside-out roll (uramaki): the rice is on the outside, so the nori goes on the mat rough side up, gets covered edge to edge with rice, then is flipped over before the filling goes on. Just One Cookbook's spicy tuna roll with a strip of mango added for sweetness. Start with sushi rice at room temperature.

notes.html:
• The mango (about ¼ of a mango per two rolls — my guess, adjust to your taste) and cutting into 8 instead of 6.
  • JOC cuts each roll in half, then each half in 3.

• For nori on the outside: nori shiny side down, spread the rice leaving a 2–3 cm strip bare along the far edge, put the filling on the rice and roll — the bare strip seals the roll.
  • No plastic wrap needed.

• Roll tighter and keep pressure on the mat as you go.
  • Too much filling also splits the roll — keep the row thin.

• Buy tuna sold for raw eating and keep it cold until you roll.
  • Don't keep the rolls in the fridge for long: the rice goes hard.

steps.body_html:
• Stir together:
    • japanese mayonnaise (kewpie) 60 ml (¼ cup)
    • sriracha (for the mayo) 1 tbsp
    • lime juice a splash
  • Set aside for the top.

steps.title: Spicy mayo

steps.body_html:
• Cut the tuna into 5 mm cubes (or mince it).
  • Toss in a bowl with:
    • sriracha 3 tsp
    • toasted sesame oil ½ tsp
    • green onions 2
  • Keep a few scallion rounds back for the top.

steps.title: Set up the mat

uses_rows.amount_html: 1 sheet

steps.body_html:
• Mix the tezu and wet your fingers in it.
  • Spread 110 g of rice evenly over the whole nori, right to the edges — it ends up outside.
  • Sprinkle with 1 tbsp sesame seeds.

steps.title: Filling along the near edge

steps.body_html:
• Hold the filling in place with your fingers.
  • Lift the near edge of the mat with your thumbs and roll the nori quickly and tightly over the filling.
  • Tuck the edge in, then pull the far end of the mat towards you to keep gentle pressure.

steps.title: Roll forwards

steps.body_html:
• Lay the mat over the roll and squeeze gently along its length to set the shape.
  • Make the second roll the same way.

steps.title: Squeeze to set

steps.body_html:
• Wipe a very sharp knife with a damp cloth.
  • Cut the roll in half, each half in half, then each piece in half again — 8 pieces.
  • Wipe the blade every cut or two. Cutting through the plastic wrap keeps the rice off your fingers.
